summary: Pin is on a private depot access track, steep, beside a working quarry.
reasons: Mapped private asphalt track at the pin
Narrow gardens road below, no pull-off

drivers.seclusion: Wooded strip between a quarry yard and the gardens road, but it is a working service route.
drivers.access_and_room: Short sealed spur marked private leads up to the depot. No bay or verge beside the gardens road to stop clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quarry trucks and staff cars use the area; gardens road is close below.
drivers.convention: Staff cars park along the depot road to the north-east; no visitor parking seen.

flags: Mapped access=private on the way at the pin
Quarry noise and dust from the west
sun_shade: Trees overhead and to the west and south; open to the morning sun from the east.
